mentions.name: Unpoll
mentions.description: This service manages the polling layer for the WhatsApp Agent API: it handles polling, cursors, webhooks, and retries so serverless apps that scale down to zero can send and receive messages via plain HTTP requests and webhooks. Agent tokens are stored encrypted.
mentions.problem: The WhatsApp Agent API requires a constant poller, which is a poor fit for serverless apps that scale down to zero when there's no traffic.
mentions.audience: Developers building serverless apps and WhatsApp agents
mentions.source_excerpt: So I built Unpoll (unpoll.cc) that takes care of polling, cursor, webhooks and retries. You can simply add your agent's token which is stored encrypted and then send & receive messages by plain old HTTP requests and webhooks.
mentions.author: sarmadgulzar
